title: Driving and mechanics
learning_outcomes: Explain road risk in the context of driving and mechanics.
Compare and distinguish vehicle systems in the context of driving and mechanics.
Apply inspection and warning signs in the context of driving and mechanics.
Evaluate and justify decisions about local rules in the context of driving and mechanics.

lessons.title: Road risk
lessons.outcome: Explain road risk in the context of driving and mechanics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving road risk; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to vehicle and journey checklist.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain road risk from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of road risk; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Vehicle systems
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish vehicle systems in the context of driving and mechanics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving vehicle systems; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to vehicle and journey checklist.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain vehicle systems from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of vehicle systems; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Inspection and warning signs
lessons.outcome: Apply inspection and warning signs in the context of driving and mechanics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving inspection and warning signs; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to vehicle and journey checklist.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain inspection and warning signs from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of inspection and warning signs; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Local rules
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about local rules in the context of driving and mechanics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving local rules; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to vehicle and journey checklist.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain local rules from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of local rules; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of road risk; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of vehicle systems; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of inspection and warning signs; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of local rules; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
